اختيار المصوّرة قرار يبقى أثره سنوات في: Choosing the right photographer leaves an impact in your album for years. These steps help you choose calmly without rushing.
أول سؤال يجب أن تطرحيه على نفسك: كيف أري: The first question to ask yourself is: How do I want my photos to look after ten years? Some photographers prefer a natural style capturing moments as they are, others favor posed shots and calculated lighting, while some blend both. There’s no better or worse style, but there’s one that suits you best.
اجمعي عشر صور تحبينها من أعراس مختلفة، و: Collect ten photos from different weddings you love, then see what they have in common: warm colors, close-ups, laughing moments, or wide frames. Then compare them with a photographer's portfolio. When you find someone whose work matches your taste, you’ve made half the journey.
اقرئي المعرض كاملاً وليس الصور الأولى فق: Read the entire portfolio, not just the first few images
الصور الأولى في أي معرض هي الأفضل عادة،: The best photos are usually at the beginning of any portfolio, which is normal. But what matters is consistency: Is lighting quality good in crowded rooms too? Are guests’ faces natural? Are small details like rings and bouquets preserved? Look for a complete wedding day rather than isolated shots to see how the photographer tells your story from start to finish.
انتبهي أيضاً للمواقع المشابهة لموقع عرسك: Also pay attention to similar venues. If your venue is an enclosed space with poor lighting, look for work by photographers in similar conditions.

تختلف الباقات في ما تشمله، وليس الفرق في: Packages differ in what they offer, not just the name. Check each package’s details: number of coverage hours, whether it includes preparation, ceremony, and reception, delivered photo count, color correction included, and delivery time frame. Also ensure a second photographer if your wedding is large.
